transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in today?

I keep getting these nagging thoughts that I’ve missed some tiny mistake in a layout, or sent the wrong version to a client. Even when I can see it’s probably fine, I just keep going back over it in my head.

When you have these thoughts about mistakes, do you find yourself repeatedly checking your work, re-reading emails, or seeking reassurance from others to feel better, even after you've already confirmed it's correct?

Yes. Before I submit something, I’ll reopen the file, compare the layers again, and save it one more time. Sometimes I go through each design choice in my head too. It doesn’t take over my whole day, but it definitely slows me down and makes it harder to feel creatively free.

When you have these thoughts and feel the urge to recheck things, do they feel like unwanted intrusions that cause you distress and that you wish you could just stop, or do they feel more like your own natural standards for doing things right?

They feel unwanted. I know it’s probably fine, but I still get this thought that I missed some tiny layout mistake or sent the wrong version, and my mind just keeps circling back to it. I wish I could let it go more easily.
Roughly how much time would you say you spend each day on these checking behaviors and the thoughts that trigger them?

Maybe around an hour or so, depending on the project. It’s mostly right before I submit something—I’ll reopen the file, compare the layers, save it again, and go through the choices in my head. It doesn’t consume the whole day, but it definitely slows me down.
How long have you been experiencing these intrusive thoughts and checking behaviors—days, weeks, months, or longer?
I’m not really sure how long it’s been going on. I’ve noticed it more with certain projects, but I can’t pin down whether it’s been weeks or longer.

Thinking back, can you recall roughly when you first started noticing these checking behaviors and intrusive thoughts—was it within the last month, or has it been going on for several months or longer?
I honestly can’t say for sure. I’ve noticed it on and off with projects, but I don’t have a clear sense of whether it started recently or has been going on longer.
Do you notice similar intrusive thoughts or checking urges in other parts of your life outside of work, like at home or with personal tasks?

Mostly it’s work-related. I keep thinking I’ve missed some tiny mistake in a layout or sent the wrong version to a client, and even when I can see it’s probably fine, my mind just keeps circling back to it.
Would you say these thoughts and checking rituals cause you significant distress or interfere with your ability to complete work tasks and meet deadlines?

I’m still getting the work done, but it’s definitely slowing me down. I’ve missed some internal deadlines because I keep going back over things, and I’ve been holding back on bolder ideas because I’m worried I’ll miss something and hurt my chances of moving into a creative director role.
